public.title: Word Ladder
public.description: Return the minimum number of words in a sequence from begin to end that changes exactly one character per step. Every word after begin must belong to words; return zero when impossible. If begin equals end return one. All words are lowercase ASCII of the same length, 1 to 8; dictionary has at most 500 distinct words.
hints: Breadth-first search explores transformations by distance.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

javascript.signature: wordLadder(begin: string, end: string, words: string[]): number

typescript.signature: wordLadder(begin: string, end: string, words: string[]): number

explanation: Generate all one-letter neighbors and remove dictionary words as they are queued. The first arrival at end is shortest. O(dictionary size times length times alphabet) time.
